title: Prospective State-Level Risk Category Test

unitUniverse.rule: US states/territories with >=6 records and >=4 distinct years, inherited UNCHANGED from RISK_SCORE_MIN_TOTAL_INCIDENTS=6 / RISK_SCORE_MIN_TOTAL_YEARS=4, plus the >=3-factor floor.
unitUniverse.exclusionNote: Both are data-quality defects referred to the DQ-01 queue. Excluded BEFORE scoring, on schema grounds, not on any outcome basis.
unitUniverse.thinStates: 6 units hold 6-8 records. The eligibility threshold was NOT raised after observing that District of Columbia ranks #3 on six records; adjusting the universe in response to an observed score would defeat the purpose of the freeze. Thin status is DISCLOSED per unit and reported at scoring, not corrected by moving a constant.

modelDefinition.basis: Faithful transposition of the production six-factor country Risk Score to state level. Weights UNCHANGED (recentActivity 25, historicalBaseline 20, acceleration 20, geographicClustering 15, casualtySeverity 10, temporalSeasonal 10); tier thresholds UNCHANGED (>=80 veryhigh, >=60 high, >=40 elevated, else lower); >=3-factor floor UNCHANGED.
transpositions: historicalBaseline: percentile rank among STATES rather than countries
casualtySeverity: percentile rank among STATES rather than countries
geographicClustering: share of a state's records in its top CITY (one level down from the country model's top-state share)
temporalSeasonal: computed for the three months following the freeze date (Sep/Oct/Nov 2026)
modelDefinition.note: No state-level Risk Score existed in production. This definition was frozen BEFORE any state was scored and is recorded in full so the computation is reproducible from the input artifact alone.

separabilityDiagnostic.meaning: The risk score is nearly uncorrelated with incident volume, so the primary comparison is NOT degenerate — score and baseline make materially different predictions (California baseline #2 / score #28; Florida #3 / #30; Pennsylvania #6 / #1; DC #25 / #3).
separabilityDiagnostic.computedPreFreeze: Uses PREDICTORS ONLY. No outcome data existed at freeze time.

outcomeDefinition: For each frozen unit: whether >=1 qualifying US incident carrying that state value occurs with a date in (2026-08-24, 2027-08-24]. Scored from the NHIRA record as it stands at window close.
primaryTest: Spearman rank correlation between scoreRank and outcome, compared against the same statistic for baselineRank. The question is whether the risk score ranks states BETTER THAN a historical-rate-only ranking — not whether it beats random.
secondaryTest: 2x2: tier in {veryhigh, high} vs {elevated, lower} against incident/no-incident.
preDeclaredNull: The risk score provides no useful ordering information beyond the historical-rate baseline: its rank correlation with outcomes is not distinguishable from the baseline's. A result consistent with this null is a REAL AND REPORTABLE OUTCOME, not a failed experiment.

interpretation.noThreshold: Estimation only. No alpha, no pass/fail, no deployment authorization. A favourable result authorizes nothing on the public site and would require its own separately pre-registered decision.
interpretation.allUnitsScored: Every frozen unit is scored — hits AND misses. Reporting only the states where an incident occurred would reproduce exactly the post-hoc selection error this experiment exists to avoid.
interpretation.noAmendment: No unit may be added or removed, and no score changed, for any reason during the window. If the input artifact changes, THIS artifact still governs.
